summary: Competing in a data centre cooling design competition and rebuilding team operations.
16-month co-op. Led a portfolio of planned-outage and in-service plant modification projects under engineering change control, and built reporting tools used by 30+ projects across 3 departments.
Helped design a machine-learning model evaluating heat-pump cost and energy use for the TRCA, and analyzed energy use across five building types for the West5 Smart Solar Community.
Reviewed contractor damage reports to assess coverage on catastrophe insurance claims.
Led the team's pivot from competition-only work to a long-term modular drone. Built recruiting and member-development systems. Manage budget, procurement and funding pitches.
